_meta.anthropic/searchHint: tv remote dpad d-pad navigate focus up down left right select ok back home menu play pause rewind fast forward sequence path apple tv tvos android tv leanback vega fire tv

description:
Press a TV remote / D-pad button (or a whole path of them) on a TV device: Apple TV (tvOS), Android TV (leanback), or Vega (Fire TV).
A TV is navigated with a directional remote, not touch. Use when you need to move focus or press a key on a TV, instead of gesture-tap/swipe (which do not apply on a TV).
Read the screen with `describe` before and after to see where focus landed.
Returns { pressed, count }. Fails on a target that is not a TV, and on the Apple TV simulator for rewind, fastForward, next, previous, volumeUp, volumeDown and mute (its HID stack ignores them); every other button works on all three platforms.

button.description: A single TV-remote button, or a path of them run in one call. Move focus with up/down/left/right, confirm with select, go back with back/menu, exit with home; the media and volume buttons press the matching remote keys. For multi-step navigation pass an array, e.g. ["up","right","right","select"]; strongly prefer this over multiple `tv-remote` calls: the whole path runs in a single call. Max items: 64.

repeat.description: Repeat the whole `button` value this many times (default 1). Compact for long same-button runs, e.g. { button: "down", repeat: 12 }. Range: 1 to 50.

udid.description: Target TV device id from `list-devices` (Apple TV, Android TV, or Vega).

name: tv-remote
